propositions: Batching N candidates into one call per ordering reduces judge calls from 2N to 2*ceil(N/batch), eliminating repeated prefix transmission and reducing input tokens by ~48% versus pre-8415 baseline

System prompt must describe batch protocol (labelled candidate lists, per-candidate independence) to cross 1024-token cache minimum, enabling prefix caching at +436 tokens and achieving write 1,331 / read 1,331 per pair of calls

Demultiplexing by candidate label rather than position ensures each candidate receives exactly one verdict even if batch response is reordered, with absent or unlabelled entries abstaining only that candidate

Systematic verdict relation shifts occur under batching (6/12 ordered pairs diverge reproducibly), mostly toward conservative unrelated/related_distinct classifications, but duplicates remain recoverable at full confidence
Batched judge abstains on runner errors and malformed responses without exception propagation, preserving advisory fail-safe semantics
